# TE2SR — Google Play Closed Testing & App Store Publishing

> Global mobile app testing and store deployment service. Providing 12 opted-in testers for 14 continuous days on real Android devices to meet Google Play Console closed testing requirements, full App Store Connect publishing, and website QA. Supporting 8 languages for developers worldwide.

TE2SR (Testing to Store Release) works exclusively on real physical devices (no emulators, no bots). Every bug report comes with screenshots and reproducible steps so developers can fix issues immediately.

## Core Services & Transparent Pricing

Fixed pricing with flexible 2-step installment (50% upfront once 12 testers start, 50% upon app live in store):

- **Google Play Closed Testing (QA)**: 12 real testers for 14 continuous days on real Android hardware. Meets Google Play December 2024 policy. Guaranteed production access questions assistance. **$50**.
- **App Store Publishing**: Store Connect configuration, certificate/signing setup, metadata, ASO screenshots, privacy policy declaration, and Apple guideline rejection handling. **$70**.
- **Dual Store Package (Both Stores)**: Complete end-to-end service for Google Play (12 testers x 14 days) + Apple App Store. **$100**.
- **Bonus**: 10 genuine 5-star starter reviews upon successful store publication.

## Custom & Enterprise Services

- **Web QA Testing**: Multi-browser end-to-end testing (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge across mobile, tablet, desktop), Core Web Vitals audit, security & vulnerability assessment.
- **ASO (App Store Optimization)**: Keyword research, title/subtitle/description optimization, localized screenshot design.
- **Custom Development & Store Rejection Rescue**: Code & metadata fix for rejected apps under Google & Apple developer guidelines.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What are the Google Play closed testing requirements?**
For personal developer accounts created after November 2023, Google Play requires at least 12 opted-in testers who test the app continuously for 14 days before applying for production access. (Rule updated in December 2024 from 20 to 12 testers). Testers must be genuine Google accounts on real physical hardware.

**How long does it take?**
At least 14 days from the date Google reviews and approves the closed testing release. Real-time progress is trackable in the client portal.

**Payment method?**
2 installments (50% + 50%). Accepted via Bank Transfer (Vietnam QR) and Binance Pay (USDT/crypto) for international clients.

**Refund policy?**
100% money-back guarantee if TE2SR fails to maintain 12 active testers for the full 14 days.
